title: Randomized interleaved majority tree
statement: Define a randomized decision tree for the depth-two recursive three-input majority function on nine sign coordinates. Its seed is chosen from the set of ordered quadruples of elements of a three-element set, with the specified seed distribution, and each seed selects a deterministic tree that computes the function exactly.
hypotheses_covered: The seed space is the set of ordered quadruples of elements of a three-element set
A probability mass function is specified on the seed space
Each seed selects a deterministic decision tree on nine sign coordinates
Every selected tree computes the depth-two recursive majority function exactly
caveat: The formal statement names the seed distribution and the computation fact without giving their definitions.
